name: Knock Knock
summary: A sunny courtyard sign-in whose Sign in button has a tiny door a little visitor walks through
about: A full sign-in page shaped like a small Mediterranean house, with a clay-tiled arch, a swinging lantern, a potted plant and a window cat at night. The Sign in button holds a tiny blue door: its peephole eye follows your typing, and a little bean-shaped visitor with a scarf walks up, knocks and steps inside when the details are right. Good for community apps, member clubs, games and any playful brand.
how: The page settles in: the roof tiles drop, the house rises and the visitor waves from beside the door
Type your email and the peephole eye and the visitor both follow the caret; focus the password and the peephole shutter slides shut while the visitor politely turns away
Press the eye button to show the password and the shutter opens just a crack
Press Sign in: the visitor walks up, knocks twice, a key turns, and with the demo details the door swings open in warm light and the visitor steps inside
Then the whole facade opens like double doors to a Welcome home panel with falling petals; Step back out walks everything back
Wrong details lock the door with a rattling padlock while the visitor bumps its head and shrugs; empty fields make it point at what is missing
